info.text:
Your income counts for 0% of a FICO Score.

FICO weights: payment history 35%, amounts owed 30%, length of history 15%, new credit 10%, credit mix 10%. Scores run 300 to 850.
Example: a $600 balance on a $2,000 limit = 30% of available credit in use.
Income, savings and employment are not in the score.
The average US FICO Score was 695 in April 2015, peaked at 718 in 2023 and was 714 in FICO's August 2026 report.

Sources: myFICO; FICO Credit Insights reports (2025-2026); Experian.
News and education, not financial advice.
